prompt:
Use your built-in image_gen tool to make exactly 1 separate image from this spec. Follow the spec literally, do not add text, logos or watermarks unless the spec asks. Do not run shell commands or write files. When done, reply with the absolute path of each generated image file, one per line, nothing else.

SPEC:
A sprite sheet of 20 map legend icons for a dark-fantasy East Asian RPG city map, arranged in a strict grid of 5 columns and 4 rows with wide equal gaps, each icon centred in its cell, all the same size. Background: solid pure chroma green #00FF00 everywhere around and between the icons, no shadows on the background. Every icon is a round medallion in the same UI kit as the attached inventory: slim antique copper-gold rim with tiny diamond studs, deep black-red lacquer disc, and a bold simple gold-and-crimson emblem in the middle that reads at 32 px. Row 1: fortress gate with fangs; palace pagoda roof; crossed katanas (arena); dragon fountain water drop; scroll with seal (guild hall). Row 2: sake bottle and cup (tavern); coin pouch (bazaar); crossed spears with helmet (barracks); glowing crystal orb (shaman tower); ox head (buffalo yard). Row 3: stone cairn burial mound (kurgans); sakura branch (garden); wolf head (kennels); chisel and brush (masters street); felt yurt (clan quarters). Row 4: hammer on anvil (forge); horse head (stable); grinning oni mask (goblin quarter); golden exclamation mark (quest); crimson skull (enemy camp). NO text, NO letters, NO numbers.
Input images: Image 1: reference for style, shapes and composition.
Aspect: landscape 3:2.
